question: The Ravi, Chenab and Jhelum are tributaries of river:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indus River:-**

 
 
• The Indus River is the longest river in Pakistan and one of the most important rivers in the region.
 
• It originates in the Tibetan Plateau and flows through India and Pakistan before emptying into the Arabian Sea.
 
• **The Ravi, Chenab, and Jhelum are all major tributaries of the Indus River, and they contribute significantly to its flow.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kaveri River:-
 
 
• **The Kaveri River, also known as the Cauvery River, is a sacred river in South India. **
 
• It originates in the Brahmagiri Hills of the Western Ghats and flows for about 765 kilometers (475 miles) through the states of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu before emptying into the Bay of Bengal. 
 
 
 
• Tungabhadra River:-
 
 
• **The Tungabhadra River is a tributary of the Krishna River. **
 
• It is formed by the confluence of the Tunga and Bhadra rivers near Shimoga in Karnataka.
 
• The Tungabhadra River flows for about 531 kilometers (330 miles) before joining the Krishna River at Sangameswaram in Andhra Pradesh. 
 
 
 
• Krishna River:-
 
 
• **The Krishna River is the second-longest river in peninsular India. **
 
• It originates in the Western Ghats near Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra and flows for about 1,400 kilometers (870 miles) through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh before emptying into the Bay of Bengal.
